target.title: fix(cron): batch pending-media snapshot in session reaper to avoid O(SxT) loop
target.body:
#### What Problem This Solves

Close #105694

Fixes an O(S × T) CPU bottleneck in the cron session reaper that blocks the Node.js event loop on each timer tick. For every cron continuation row, `sweepCronRunSessions` called `hasPendingGeneratedMediaTaskForSessionKey`, which internally performs `listTaskRecords` — a full cloned-and-sorted snapshot of all task records plus in-process generated-media activity. With thousands of sessions, this synchronous work saturates the main thread and causes gateway timeout / WebSocket disconnection.

#### Why This Change Was Made

Instead of changing the per-row `hasPendingGeneratedMediaTaskForSessionKey` helper (still used by the single-invocation `cron-run-continuation-cleanup` path), this adds `buildPendingGeneratedMediaSessionKeySet` — a one-shot snapshot that collects all session keys with pending generated-media work by iterating the in-process activity map once and the full task registry once. The reaper then does O(1) `Set.has()` lookups inside the loop.

Key design decisions:
- Preserves the exact `requesterSessionKey` / `ownerKey` matching contract — no semantic change, only a scan-lifting optimization
- The snapshot is deliberately conservative: session keys that the reaper never visits may still be included, which is harmless
- ClawSweeper confirmed the shape: "one canonical bulk pending-generated-media session-key snapshot that combines active in-process work with nonterminal persisted requester and owner keys"

#### User Impact

No visible impact. The cron reaper produces identical pruning decisions with strictly less CPU time per sweep.

#### Evidence

- **Type check:** `tsgo` passes with no errors
- **Unit tests:**
  - `task-status-access.test.ts` — 10 tests pass (+6: `buildPendingGeneratedMediaSessionKeySet`)
  - `session-reaper.test.ts` — 20 tests pass (mock updated to use `buildPendingSet`)
  - `cron-run-continuation-cleanup.test.ts` — 5 tests pass (no regression)
- **Change scope:** 5 files, +131 −7 lines
  - `src/tasks/generated-media-task-activity.ts` — new `getAllActiveGeneratedMediaSessionKeys` export
  - `src/tasks/task-status-access.ts` — new `buildPendingGeneratedMediaSessionKeySet` helper
  - `src/cron/session-reaper.ts` — one snapshot call before the loop, `Set.has()` per row
  - `src/tasks/task-status-access.test.ts` — 6 new tests
  - `src/cron/session-reaper.test.ts` — mock updated for new function
  - No config, CLI, SDK, docs, or changelog surface affected
- **No new dependencies** — reuses existing `listTaskRecords`, `getActiveGeneratedMediaTasks`, `isTerminalTaskStatus`
- **Timing proof:** the `listTaskRecords` mock performs real clone+sort work on every call (matching production). Old and new paths are compared side-by-side at realistic scale with wall-clock measurement. The reaper was seeded with 500 cron continuation sessions and real `sweepCronRunSessions` verified the production code path.

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cron/_proof-reaper-timing.test.ts --reporter verbose

 ✓ new path calls listTaskRecords exactly once at S=500 (old would call ~250x)

  [S=500, T=200]
  new path: buildPending + 500x Set.has → 0.76ms
  old path: 50x hasPending (sampled)   → 4.58ms
  old path projected (500x):           → 45.81ms
  speedup: 60.4x
  pending set: 83, new hits: 43, old hits (sampled): 30
  sweep result: swept=true, pruned=457

 ✓ new and old produce identical decisions on sampled rows

  correctness: 100/100 match, 0 mismatch
  pending set size: 165

 ✓ requesterSessionKey + ownerKey both captured, terminal excluded
   (video_generation processing → both keys in set; succeeded task excluded; chat excluded)

 ✓ scale: at S=1000, new path still sub-millisecond

  [S=1000, T=500] pending set: 105, loop hits: 210
  total (buildPending + 1000x Set.has): 0.77ms
  old path projected: ~192.7ms (500 continuation rows × clone+sort)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

- **S=500, T=200:** 60.4x speedup (0.76ms new vs 45.81ms old projected)
- **S=1000, T=500:** ~250x speedup (0.77ms new vs ~192.7ms old projected)
- **Correctness:** 100/100 sampled rows produce identical old-vs-new decisions
- **Contract:** `requesterSessionKey` + `ownerKey` both captured; terminal tasks excluded; non-generated-media ignored
